title: When does text encoding matter for language modeling?
abstract: arXiv:2611.14459v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: UTF-8's role as the de facto encoding standard in language models introduces cross-lingual inequities due to its variable-length design. However, the effect that this encoding choice has on model performance remains largely unexamined. In this work, we investigate how text encoding impacts the performance of byte-level language models, comparing UTF-8 with a wide range of other encoding strategies, including other Unicode-based approaches, language-specific encodings, and our own customized encodings. To facilitate our analysis, we propose Aether: a hybrid encoding scheme that uses script-specific encodings for our target setting while maintaining full Unicode coverage through UTF-8 fallbacks, using this framework to model four orthographically diverse languages. translated_title: 文本编码何时对语言建模有影响？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.14459v1 公告类型：新 摘要：UTF-8 作为语言模型中事实上的编码标准，由于其可变长度设计而引入了跨语言的不平等。然而，这种编码选择对模型性能的影响在很大程度上仍未被研究。在这项工作中，我们研究了文本编码如何影响字节级语言模型的性能，将 UTF-8 与多种其他编码策略进行比较，包括其他基于 Unicode 的方法、特定语言的编码以及我们自己定制的编码。为便于分析，我们提出了 Aether：一种混合编码方案，它在我们的目标设定中使用针对特定文字的编码，同时通过 UTF-8 回退机制保持对完整 Unicode 的覆盖，并利用该框架对四种正字法各不相同的语言进行建模。令人惊讶的是，我们发现具有信息密集字符的语言（如中文、韩语）能从压缩编码中显著受益，而其字符承载……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出混合编码方案 Aether，并系统研究了文本编码对字节级语言模型性能的影响，发现中文、韩语等信息密集文字的语言能从压缩编码中显著受益，从而揭示了编码选择带来的跨语言性能差异。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Aether, a hybrid encoding scheme, and shows that text encoding choices significantly affect byte-level language model performance, with information-dense scripts like Chinese and Korean benefiting substantially from compressive encodings.
